description.value: Family-run campground on Highway 20 in the Bella Coola Valley, deep in the Great Bear Rainforest amid glacier-fed rivers, old-growth forest, and abundant wildlife; flush toilets, coin showers, and laundry on-site with town minutes away.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a small, family-run campground established 2021 in the Bella Coola Valley (Hagensborg), offering campsites and cabins. Showers are confirmed ('coin-operated showers' in Shower House), laundry confirmed ('coin-operated laundry facilities'), food nearby confirmed ('minutes from shops, dining, and local amenities'), and reservations confirmed ('Reservations must be made by phone call, text or email'). Significant phone number discrepancy: OSM lists +1-250-982-2504 but the website consistently shows 250-644-3524. The OSM name omits '& Cabins' which the website uses throughout.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-250-982-2504 but website consistently shows 250-644-3524. Using website number as more likely current.
OSM name is 'Bella Coola Valley Campground' but website branding is 'Bella Coola Valley Campground & Cabins'. Kept OSM name per rules.
OSM address field is empty; address '1875 Highway 20, Hagensborg, BC V0T 1H0' sourced from website contact page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active campground on Highway 20 in the Bella Coola Valley with showers, laundry, and proximity to town services. Clear fit for touring cyclists riding the Hill or exploring the Central Coast.
enrichment_extras.notes: Also has a sani-station on site. Located in an area with cellular service. Cabins are not pet-friendly.
